children: reported record third-quarter 2026 net income of $11.4 million, or $1.64 basic EPS ($1.61 diluted), up from $5.1 million a year earlier. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, the company posted net income of $31.1 million, or $4.46 basic EPS ($4.40 diluted), driven by higher net interest income and a substantially lower provision for credit losses. Return on average assets and equity improved materially year-over-year, while deposits and available liquidity increased.
Q3 2026 net income: $11.4 million (Q3 2025: $5.1 million); diluted EPS Q3 2026: $1.61 (Q3 2025: $0.73).
Nine months 2026 net income: $31.1 million (nine months 2025: $18.6 million); diluted EPS YTD 2026: $4.40 (YTD 2025: $2.94).
Net interest income Q3 2026: $26.5 million (Q3 2025: $25.2 million); net interest income YTD Sep 30, 2026: $77.7 million (YTD 2025: $61.9 million).
Provision for credit losses Q3 2026: $150 thousand (Q3 2025: $5.4 million); YTD provision for credit losses 2026: $420 thousand (YTD 2025: $6.5 million).
Key profitability metrics — Q3 2026 annualized return on average assets: 1.98%; return on average equity: 16.7% (Q3 2025: 0.90% and 8.5%, respectively).
Loan portfolio composition at Sept. 30, 2026: gross loans $1.496 billion, with approximately 79% variable-rate exposure and commercial real estate representing 67.9% of total loans.

Loan mix changes year-over-year included increases of $35 million in commercial real estate, $5 million in construction loans and $1 million in equity lines, offset by runoff in indirect auto (-$20 million) and reductions in agricultural (-$15 million) and commercial loans (-$2 million).
Deposits grew $47 million year-over-year to $1.867 billion; non-interest-bearing demand deposits comprised about 46% of total deposits and money market balances increased materially.
Investment securities portfolio totaled $475 million with an increased unrealized loss position of $44 million at Sept. 30, 2026; cash and due from banks rose to $114 million.
Asset quality: nonperforming loans $21.1 million (1.41% of loans) and nonperforming assets $21.3 million (0.94% of total assets); allowance for credit losses $19.7 million (1.32% of total loans).
